description: This file defines a service interface 'IWeatherService' for obtaining weather forecasts in the WeatherApi application. It declares a method GetForecast that generates weather forecast data based on parameters such as city, days, and units.

classes.name: IWeatherService
classes.description: Interface for weather forecast services, providing a method to retrieve forecast data.

methods.name: GetForecast
methods.description: Generates a weather forecast for a specified city over a number of days with specified units.
